mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_member WHERE delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_member WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_member_dormant WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND restored_at IS NULL

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tb_member WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL #{months} - 1 MONTH) GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
SELECT status AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tb_member WHERE delete_yn = 'N' GROUP BY status ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_master WHERE delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_article WHERE delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_comment WHERE delete_yn = 'N'

SELECT m.bbs_name AS label, COUNT(a.article_id) AS value FROM tb_bbs_master m LEFT JOIN tb_bbs_article a ON a.bbs_master_id = m.bbs_master_id AND a.delete_yn = 'N' WHERE m.delete_yn = 'N' AND m.use_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY m.bbs_master_id, m.bbs_name ORDER BY value DESC, label LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tb_bbs_article WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL #{months} - 1 MONTH) GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_file WHERE delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0) FROM tb_file WHERE delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT extension AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tb_file WHERE delete_yn = 'N' GROUP BY extension ORDER BY value DESC, label LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT virus_scan_status AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tb_file WHERE delete_yn = 'N' GROUP BY virus_scan_status ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT status AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tb_content WHERE delete_yn = 'N' GROUP BY status ORDER BY value DESC
